description: Current piracy and armed-robbery broadcasts from the ICC International Maritime Bureau (IMB) Piracy Reporting Centre: broadcast time (UTC), IMB identifier, category (attack, attempted attack, suspicious activity, warning...), location (e.g. Gulf of Aden, Singapore Straits) and the full narration, plus the cancel time when the message states one. Filter by location or category words. Price: $0.002 in USDC per successful call, paid with x402 (Base, Solana or Arc); failed calls are not charged.

category.description: Optional words of the category, e.g. warning, suspicious, boarded

location.description: Optional words of the location, e.g. Gulf of Aden, Singapore
